skill_name: Describe the challenges and opportunities of mobile phone use in developing countries
workflow: The use of mobile phones in developing countries can present challenges as well as many opportunities. On the one hand, access to mobile phones can reduce digital divides and enable access to information, education, and healthcare. However, there is also a lack of regulation, leading to a number of privacy and safety risks.
